_about: PAR-1067: ml-bench model-name prefixes whose weights' licence excludes production use (docs/ml/foundation-models/README.md#licences). Read by mlbench/licences.py (refuse_benchmark_only, which every verdict writer such as served_verdicts must call before it emits an entry) and by src/ml/utils/benchmark-only-models.spec.ts (no verdict, decision or matrix entry may name one). Add a prefix here when a new benchmark-only model is benchmarked.

prefixes.timesfm3: TimesFM Non-Commercial License v1.0 (TimesFM 3.x): non-commercial and non-production use only
prefixes.tabpfn: TABPFN-3.5 License v1.0 (TabPFN-TS on TabPFN-3.5 weights): non-commercial, non-production
